summary: Stores a 3-component vector (a2, a3, a4) as floats at this+0x44/+0x48/+0x4C, normalizes all three components to unit length when the vector length is non-zero, then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with the global dword_8B78A0, this and its handle at this+0x4 under mode 5, and finally ORs dirty flag 0x800 into dword_8B8F28+236.

local_names.this: vertex-buffer object holding the vector and the buffer handle
local_names.a2: X component of the stored vector
local_names.a3: Y component of the stored vector
local_names.a4: Z component of the stored vector
local_names.v5: reciprocal of the vector length used for normalization
local_names.result: dword_8B8F28 global returned by the function

operations.description: Store the incoming vector verbatim: this+0x44 = a2, this+0x48 = a3, this+0x4C = a4
v4 = sqrt(a2*a2 + a3*a3 + a4*a4) computes the vector length
Normalization only proceeds when the computed length v4 is non-zero; otherwise the original un-normalized values are kept
Reciprocal 1.0/v4 scales each component back into this+0x44/+0x48/+0x4C, producing a unit-length vector
DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, *(this+4), 5) pushes the updated vector into the vertex buffer using the buffer handle at this+0x4
OR 0x800 into dword_8B8F28+236 to flag the buffer state as dirty
Return dword_8B8F28 as the function result
